'''Memorial droids''' were [[Droid/Legends|droids]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Great Galactic War]] with the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. After the [[Battle of Rhen Var]], the memorial droids were used to recite all the names of the Republic casualties, taking them three full [[Standard day|days]].
